name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Holiday bit-cache lifecycle now matches the requested policy. For the selected Japan/England-Wales/Scotland/Northern-Ireland setting, prewarm only the real current year and next year after Orbit has already drawn. If calendar scrolling later reaches any other year, generate that whole 366-bit/46-byte year table on first need and persist it too. Never auto-delete old years or inactive-region caches. Keep the existing Holiday cache settings submenu so the user can manually delete Japan, England/Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland, or all stored caches. Japanese year generation is also made direct/rule-based rather than scanning every date.
